solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: East Sussex town's victory over London club

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed over another comes first

parts.note: a victory is a win
Chelsea is a London football club

explanation.surface: A local paper celebrates a town's win against a big London football side.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'over' puts WIN above CHELSEA, the Premier League club from west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Winchelsea is a small historic town near Rye in East Sussex, England; the 's stands for 'is'.

clue.text: Bowled, during a trial, under the most favourable conditions

indicators.note: during places the bowled letter inside the phrase 'a trial'

parts.note: a trial is a test
B is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for bowled

explanation.surface: A batsman is dismissed in a trial match, which is not ideal.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in the best possible case, when circumstances are as good as they get.

clue.text: Leaves writer lines

parts.note: Graham Greene, the English novelist
RY, short for railway, gives lines of track

explanation.surface: A writer abandons the lines of a script.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb but is the noun, foliage; RY is the crossword abbreviation for railway.
explanation.definitionFit: Foliage collectively, plant leaves, is called greenery.

clue.text: Chapter on law imposed on American plant

indicators.note: in a down answer, on means placed above the next piece
set on top of, so it comes before in a down answer

parts.note: an act is a law passed by parliament
US means American

explanation.surface: A section of legislation is forced upon the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A succulent spiny desert plant is a cactus.

clue.text: Subsequent examination of dog at an end

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them
time is up when it is at an end

explanation.surface: A vet takes a second look at a dog whose life is ending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dog' is a verb, to tail someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A follow-up is a later check that continues an earlier examination or action.

clue.text: Fish, black when small

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: A fish turns black when it is young.
explanation.definitionFit: The bass is a common sea and freshwater fish.

clue.text: A beignet, say, may be healthier, doctor finally admitted

indicators.note: admitted means let in, so a letter goes inside the word for healthier

parts.note: fitter means in better health

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of the word doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor concedes that a doughnut might be the better option for your health.
explanation.definitionFit: A beignet is a French deep-fried pastry, an example of a fritter; 'say' marks the example.

clue.text: Honest description of old-fashioned blonde?

definitions.meaning: a fair-haired person who is square, that is old-fashioned or conventional

explanation.surface: A truthful account of a fair-haired person with dated tastes.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means fair and honest, with no cheating; read literally it describes a fair-haired square.

clue.text: A mostly forthright party delivering fruit

indicators.note: mostly drops the final letter of the word for forthright

parts.note: a vocal person speaks out frankly
a do is a party

explanation.surface: An outspoken party serves up a fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The avocado is the pear-shaped fruit of a tropical tree.

clue.text: Where the clock's hands are, as is palpably plain

definitions.meaning: clock hands sit on the dial

explanation.surface: Something is as obvious as the hands of a clock.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means apparently, as things appear, and literally a clock's hands are on its dial.

clue.text: Elected pope is harsh

parts.note: a candidate who is elected is in
Clement is the name of several popes

explanation.surface: A newly chosen pontiff is severe.
explanation.definitionFit: Inclement weather is harsh and stormy, the opposite of mild.

clue.text: Record broken by unknown composer

indicators.note: broken by means split open with another letter put inside

parts.note: to list is to record
Z is an algebraic unknown, like x and y

explanation.surface: A record of a composer is broken by someone unknown.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Liszt was the Hungarian Romantic composer and virtuoso pianist.

clue.text: A well-bred fellow envoy

parts.note: a gent is a gentleman

explanation.surface: A refined gentleman serves as a diplomat.
explanation.definitionFit: An envoy is someone sent to act on another's behalf, a representative.

clue.text: Heels were broken in some other place

indicators.note: broken signals that the letters are smashed and rearranged

explanation.surface: Her shoes snapped somewhere else.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhere different, not here, is a meaning of elsewhere.

clue.text: Prudent, comic alone in resort

indicators.note: resort read as re-sort, sort again, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A thrifty comedian is alone at a seaside resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday town but reads as re-sort, shuffling COMIC ALONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Being thrifty or careful with money is being economical, a synonym of prudent.

clue.text: Daughter is to perform on parade

parts.note: to play is to perform

explanation.surface: A daughter is going to act in a procession.
explanation.definitionFit: A parade is a show or exhibition, so it means a display.

clue.text: Songbird seen on branch line flower

indicators.note: in a down answer, seen on puts the bird above the branch

parts.note: the lark is a songbird
a spur is a short branch railway line

explanation.surface: A songbird perches on a branch beside a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Larkspur is a garden flower, the delphinium relative with spurred blooms.

clue.text: Ambassador briefly produces certificate

indicators.note: briefly cuts off the last letter of the word for ambassador

parts.note: an ambassador is a diplomat

explanation.surface: An envoy quickly hands over a certificate.
explanation.definitionFit: A diploma is the certificate awarded on finishing a course of study.

clue.text: Event for equestrian in period costume, primarily

indicators.note: primarily says the costume word comes first, ahead of the period

parts.note: dress is costume or clothing
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Riders at a horse event wear historical outfits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'period costume' reads as one phrase for historical dress, but the two words split apart, and 'primarily' says the costume comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressage is an equestrian discipline in which horse and rider perform precise movements.

clue.text: Trouble during first half of reel after square dance

indicators.note: after places the trouble-and-reel piece behind the square

parts.note: a quad is a quadrangle, a college square

indicators.note: during puts the trouble word inside the half of reel
first half of takes the opening two letters of the word reel

parts.note: ill means trouble or harm

explanation.surface: Trouble breaks out midway through a reel at a square dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'square dance' looks like the definition run together, but 'square' is the college quadrangle and 'dance' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: The quadrille is a square dance for four couples, popular in the nineteenth century.

clue.text: Large snake may make one run

parts.note: the adder is a snake

explanation.surface: A big snake might send someone running.
explanation.walkthrough: A ladder is the British word for a run in tights or stockings.
explanation.definitionFit: In British usage a ladder is a run, a line of laddered stitches in hosiery.

clue.text: Touchy about conductor's first musical arrangement

indicators.note: about means around, so the touchy word goes round a letter

parts.note: sore means touchy, aggrieved

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of conductor

explanation.surface: An irritable conductor fusses over the first arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is the written music of a composition with all its parts.

clue.text: Sordid around Turkey's capital, like the baths there?

indicators.note: around puts the sordid word around a letter

parts.note: seamy means sordid, unpleasant

indicators.note: capital means the first, capital letter of Turkey

explanation.surface: Something sordid around Turkey's capital, as in its famous baths.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' suggests Ankara but just picks the T of Turkey; 'there' points back to Turkey and its hot Turkish baths.
explanation.definitionFit: Turkish baths are hot and full of steam, so steamy describes them.

clue.text: Gather mother's upset by idiot

indicators.note: upset means turned over, so the mother word is read backwards

parts.note: ma is mother, with 's for 'is'
an ass is an idiot

explanation.surface: A mother is annoyed by a fool and must gather herself.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is to collect or accumulate, a synonym of gather.

clue.text: A short talk by Greek hero

indicators.note: short removes the last letter of the word for talk

parts.note: jaw means talk, chatter
by gives X, as in 3 by 4 for dimensions or multiplication

explanation.surface: A Greek hero has a brief chat.
explanation.definitionFit: Ajax was a mighty Greek warrior at Troy in Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: Lack of faith shown by Delibes, I suspect, before start of fugue

indicators.note: suspect as an adjective means dubious, so the letters are unreliable and rearranged
start of takes the first letter of fugue

explanation.surface: Someone doubts that Delibes, the composer, wrote a fugue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspect' rearranges DELIBES I to DISBELIE; Delibes was a French composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Disbelief is the refusal or inability to believe, an absence of faith.

clue.text: Expunction comes with time, certainly

parts.note: an era is a period of time
sure means certainly, as in 'sure, I will'

explanation.surface: Being wiped out comes with time, certainly.
explanation.definitionFit: Expunction is the act of striking out, rubbing out or deleting, which is an erasure.

clue.text: Many G and Ts poured out in tumbler

indicators.note: poured out suggests the drinks are spilled and their letters mixed

explanation.surface: Many gin and tonics are poured into a glass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tumbler' looks like a glass for the G and Ts but is an acrobat; 'and' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tumbler is an acrobat who performs somersaults, a kind of gymnast.
